correctness.rationale: For positive cyclic gaps a+b+c+d=n, the chord-direction difference is pi(a+c)/n. Counting (a,c) and (b,d) positive compositions with marked starting points gives n(s-1)(n-s-1) and correct factors 2/4; each sampled quartet is counted once. The finite law normalizes. Riemann sums give the folded beta density; the near-zero mass <=Ck/n^2 and sin(pi*k/n)>=2k/n give uniform integrability for q<2; harmonic sum yields log coefficient at q=2 and dominated convergence by C k^(1-q) yields the zeta constant for q>2. Independently computed 15,504 Euclidean 4-vertex tests for n=4..19 and 72 integer bins, plus numerical fixed-q limit checks.

final_claim: For a uniform four-vertex subset of an n-gon (n>=4), with the unique crossing diagonal pairing, the acute angle has masses 12(k-1)(n-k-1)/((n-1)(n-2)(n-3)) for 2<=k<=floor(n/2), halved at even 2k=n. Its limiting density is 12*t*(pi-t)/pi^3 and inverse-sine moments have cutoff q=2, coefficient 12/pi^2 at log n, and zeta difference above.
limitations: Exact regular polygon and uniformly chosen unordered vertex quartet; not independently random pairs of chords or unweighted distinct intersection sites.
Fixed q>=0 as n tends to infinity, and no perturbed-vertex theorem.
